body.name: fixed-dimensional finite-net positive-law estimator
body.construction:
Let \(D:=4d_zd_x+d_x\), \(b:=4\sqrt{d_zd_x}+\sqrt{d_x}\), and \(\epsilon_n:=n^{-1/2}\).  Partition the coordinate box \([-L,L]^D\) into a deterministic lexicographically ordered grid of half-open cubes of side at most \(\epsilon_n/b\).  If \(\mathscr S\ne\varnothing\), from every cube meeting \(\mathscr S\) fix one representative \(q_{n,\ell}\in\mathscr S\), and let \(\widehat q_n\) be the smallest-index minimizer of \(d_S(q_{n,\ell},\widehat S_n)\).  At \(\widehat q_n\), retain the \(k\) right singular directions of the vertically stacked proxy moment whose singular values exceed \(\pi_0\sigma_0^2/2\), call the resulting basis \(V\), and form the compressed effect operator \(\Delta\), left anchor \(a\), and right anchor \(c\) by the formulas in \(\mathrm{def:compressed\text{-}operator}\).  For each distinct eigenvalue \(\lambda\) of \(\Delta\), put \(E_\lambda:=\prod_{\gamma\ne\lambda}(\Delta-\gamma I_k)/(\lambda-\gamma)\), with the empty product equal to \(I_k\), and define
\[
\widehat\nu_n^{\mathrm{net}}:=\sum_{\lambda\in\operatorname{spec}(\Delta)}a^\top E_\lambda c\,\delta_\lambda.
\]
If \(\mathscr S=\varnothing\), define \(\widehat\nu_n^{\mathrm{net}}\) to be the unit point mass at zero.
